 THIS WRIT PETITION IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO QUASH THE AWARD DTD 12.04.2019 VIDE ANNX-D PASSED BY THE R-1 AND DIRECT TO THE R-1 TO 3 TO CONSIDER THE REPRESENTATION DTD 22.03.2019 UNDER ANNX-C WITH A DIRECTION TO PAY COMPENSATION TO THE PETITIONER IN RESPECT OF LAND BEARING SY.NO.42/1, SITUATED AT MAYAGANA HALLI VILLAGE, KASABA HOBLI, RAMANAGARA TALUK, MEASURING 556 SQ. METERS AND ETC.,
 THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:-
 ORDER
The Petitioner seeks to lay a challenge to an order of Award passed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer of National Highway Authority.

Learned panel Counsel, Smt. Sruti C Chagati and the learned AGA appearing for the other Respondents points out that Petitioner has an alternate remedy available under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 and therefore, Petitioner be relegated to the same.
There is force in this submission.
Ordered accordingly and this Writ Petition is disposed off.

It hardly needs to be stated that the period spent in prosecuting in this Writ Petition is liable to be discounted while computing the period of limitation prescribed in the said Act for invoking the alternate remedy as above.
